## Nov 05 2026, Phase 0: Full repository code review (pre-build)

(2) the dash scan prose only hyphen rule (dashScan.test.ts:10 to 16) is correctly scoped: code subtraction such as planMath.test.ts:451 legitimately contains a spaced hyphen, and the three dash code points are still checked file wide.

Verified clean: every lever gain is a difference of two shocks.runway answers and nothing else (planMath.ts:323 baseline, planMath.ts:357 per step, deltas at planMath.ts:364 to 365; the only near misses are the savings on hand disclosure at planText.ts:118 and the horizon unit conversion at planMath.ts:197, neither deriving a runway); lever semantics match the decision record (order insurance, trim, defer at planMath.ts:326 to 350; sizes from profile S, F, P, and insurance only; disc clamp max(0, S minus (F plus P)) at planMath.ts:324; exact simulated counterfactual caveats pinned identically in both languages; insurance lever fires only above zero at the full median); golden_plans.json matches the design table and three rows (68257, 23838, 42988) were recomputed by hand to the cent including ceil divisions and half up ties, asserted against the same file by both planMath.golden.test.ts and test_plans.py; scale_cents mirrors scaleCents with the round_half_up sign split (shocks.py:46 to 61); the plans.py broken import is gone and no build or verify coupling exists (git diff on both empty); goalPlan and backupPlan bodies are byte stable versus pre E4 (git diff deletes only the import line and two goalPlan doc comment lines), and the approved planText churn is documented at planText.test.ts:12 to 17 with the surplus story now delegating to goalPlan.months; display rules exact ("+X.X months", "clears the shortfall (120+ months)" with the 98952 cap crossing asserted at planText.test.ts:244, buffer depleted restore note at planText.test.ts:265); PlanCard holds zero math (formatCents and the formatMonthsToReach labeler only) and git diff on ConsoleView.tsx and consoleStore.ts is empty; the change set matches the E4 scope list exactly (nine modified plus four new files), with an untracked icon.svg appearing and vanishing mid review as concurrent work noise, never referenced by tracked source; no dash violations in any new string or in golden_plans.json (test_plans.py:825 plus the verify dash scan); every exported lever and milestone field is Number.isInteger checked (planMath.test.ts:577 to 608) and no toBeCloseTo touches money in the new tests.
